<div class="callout-note" role="note">
<h2>Get this information in a different format</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/standards-and-guidance/nz-government-web-standards/digital-accessibility-standard/das-consultation#alt">View available alternate formats</a></p>
</div>
<p>A new Digital Accessibility Standard (DAS) will replace the Web Accessibility Standard in early 2027. We’re changing the standard to make sure that accessibility is considered for all digital technology — something the current standard does not do.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/standards-and-guidance/nz-government-web-standards/digital-accessibility-standard/draft-das">Read the draft Digital Accessibility Standard (DAS)</a></p>
<h2>Your feedback matters</h2>
<p>The DAS will matter most to these groups of people:</p>
<ul>
<li>disabled people</li>
<li>people working in government, including staff and decision-makers</li>
<li>companies that provide information and services to government.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What happens with the consultation</h2>
<p>The draft DAS will be open for public consultation from Monday 13 July to Friday 7 August 2026.</p>
<p>You can share your feedback by:</p>
<ul>
<li>completing the survey online, or</li>
<li>emailing answers to the consultation questions to <a href="mailto:web.standards@gdda.govt.nz">web.standards@gdda.govt.nz</a>, or</li>
<li>replying in New Zealand Sign Language (NZSL) using NZSL.Direct.</li>
</ul>
<p>We’re not asking for any personal information. Any information you share will be kept secure and treated with care and respect. You can find out more about how information is collected and stored on our <a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/home/about-digital-govt-nz/privacy">privacy statement page</a>.</p>
<aside class="callout-survey">
<h3>Complete the survey online</h3>
<p>This survey has 18 questions. Most are multiple choice, and some will let you add extra comments. All questions are optional.</p>
<p>You can also give general feedback on the draft DAS.</p>
<p>All responses are anonymous so we cannot identify you.</p>
<p><a href="https://consultations.digital.govt.nz/standards/das-consultation/">Start the survey</a></p>
</aside>
<h3>Send feedback by email</h3>
<p>You can email your answers to the consultation questions to <a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/web.standards@gdda.govt.nz">web.standards@gdda.govt.nz</a>. Please include the question number you’re responding to.</p>
<h3>Send feedback in NZSL</h3>
<p>You can send your feedback in NZSL using NZSL.Direct. It will be confidentially and professionally translated and included in the consultation feedback. This service is free to use for this consultation.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.nzsl.direct/seeflow/">NZSL.Direct/Seeflow</a></p>
<h3>After the consultation</h3>
<p>We’ll review and analyse all responses after the consultation closes. This will help shape the final version of the DAS.</p>
<p>We’ll also talk with the people most affected by the DAS. This will help us understand what they need and how we can support them better.</p>
<p>In early 2027 we’ll publish the DAS, a summary of the feedback, and a document explaining the decisions made.</p>
<h2 id="alt">Alternate formats</h2>
<p>All the information about the DAS consultation is available in the following formats:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Standards-guidance/NZ-government-web-standards/DAS/DAS-consultation-survey-Large-print.pdf">Large print (PDF 193KB)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Standards-guidance/NZ-government-web-standards/DAS/DAS-consultation-survey-Large-print.docx">Large print (DOCX 593KB)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Standards-guidance/NZ-government-web-standards/DAS/DAS-consultation-survey-Braille.brf">Braille (BRF 16KB)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Standards-guidance/NZ-government-web-standards/DAS/DAS-consultation-survey-Easy-Read.pdf">Easy Read (PDF 2MB)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Standards-guidance/NZ-government-web-standards/DAS/DAS-consultation-survey-Easy-Read.docx">Easy Read (DOCX 8.5MB)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8wTHmJ95NVY">New Zealand Sign Language (NZSL) — YouTube</a></li>
<li>Audio — coming soon</li>
</ul>
